facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. Applications for a specific program or university occur according to the announcement on the internet. Please refer to the announcement for information on application requirements and application documents.
facts.programme_association: Supplementary Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Separate application procedures exist for European and worldwide programs. The announcement and selection for worldwide programs occur before the selection for European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, an application for the European exchange under the Erasmus+ program can be made without restrictions.
facts.programme_association: Supplementary Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The announcements and selection for worldwide and European exchanges occur simultaneously. The announcements are published at the end of October, with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
